title: SynPro
summary: SynPro is a Python/PyPI library (package name synpro) for generating synthetic tabular data with GAN architectures (WGAN-GP, R1, Hinge loss), offering conditional sampling and mixed-precision training. Its core data_transformer.py imports RDT's ClusterBasedNormalizer and OneHotEncoder directly to perform mode-specific normalization of the input columns before GAN training.
needs: Confirm whether ClusterBasedNormalizer is actually invoked (called) elsewhere in data_transformer.py beyond the import, to fully verify load-bearing use.
